Container.Name: RunescapeDragonwilds-broccoli
Container.Overview:
A dedicated server for RuneScape: DragonWilds. The server files are downloaded with DepotDownloader on first start.
Before you start: set OWNER_ID to your Player ID (at the bottom of the in-game Settings menu) and set ADMIN_PASSWORD. The server does not start without OWNER_ID.
Forward UDP port 7777 on your router. The host port and the container port must be the same. If you change the port, also change DEFAULT_PORT.
Docker image by indifferentbroccoli.
Container.Requires: 4 CPU cores, 8 GB RAM (2 GB + 1 GB per player), 10 GB storage. Your RuneScape: DragonWilds Player ID.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: runescape dragonwilds jagex dedicated server steam

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: UDP game port. Forward it on your router. The host port and the container port must be the same as DEFAULT_PORT.

Config.Name: Owner ID
Config.Description: Required. Your RuneScape: DragonWilds Player ID. Find it at the bottom of the in-game Settings menu.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Required. Password to open Server Management in-game.

Config.Name: Default World Name
Config.Description: Name of the world created on first start.

Config.Name: World Password
Config.Description: Optional password to join. Leave empty for a public server.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Maximum number of players on the server.

Config.Name: Default Port
Config.Description: UDP port the server listens on. Must be the same as the Game Port.

Config.Name: Update On Start
Config.Description: Download and validate the server files on each start. Set to false to skip.
